_comment: Compose pi data into YOUR OWN Oh My Posh theme instead of using the bundled one. Copy these segments into a block's "segments" array in your theme (keep your own colors/separators), then point the extension at that file: PI_OMP_CONFIG=~/your.omp.json. They read the .Env.PI_* variables this extension exports: PI_MODEL, PI_THINKING, PI_CTX_GAUGE, PI_CTX_PERCENT, PI_TOKENS, PI_PROVIDER, PI_CTX_WINDOW, PI_STATUS (selected other-extension statuses, joined), PI_STATUS_COUNT, and PI_STATUS_<KEY> per publisher (e.g. PI_STATUS_REMOTE_PI_SESSION). Run /oh-my-posh-status in pi to list live keys. Each segment self-hides when its data is absent (empty template output).
